exposures.description:
Thomas (aka Cnp) at 3ms pd/cd, with 500ms sequencer steps [1,2,3,1+2+3]. Based on the exposure described in:

Buckner CA, Buckner AL, Koren SA, Persinger MA, Lafrenie RM (2015) Inhibition of Cancer Cell Growth by Exposure to a Specific Time-Varying Electromagnetic Field Involves T-Type Calcium Channels. PLoS ONE 10(4): e0124136. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0124136

profile.description: Line-oriented text DAC: the first line is the point count and each following line is one decimal 8-bit sample value (0..255).

metadata.notes:
Thomas DAC pattern (aka Cnp) at 3ms point delay and 3ms cycle delay. Uses 4.08V as the 5V equivalent - to compensate for the voltage drop across the optocoupler (MOC3010) in the real-world signal path.

Original DAC points provided by Dr. Persinger circa 2008.

First described as the 'Cnp' in:

Thomas AW, Kavaliers M, Prato FS, Ossenkopp KP. Analgesic effects of a specific pulsed magnetic field in the land snail, Cepaea nemoralis: consequences of repeated exposures, relations to tolerance and cross-tolerance with DPDPE. Peptides. 1998;19(2):333-42. doi: 10.1016/s0196-9781(97)00380-x. PMID: 9493866.

--- Historical characterization notes ---

Andrew — 4D box characterization (MODEL PREDICTIONS)

Snapshot maps: three channel pairs separately and all three simultaneously, each at positive 8 mA. The user measured this typical channel peak under nominal 5 V DC, accounting for optocoupler losses not modeled explicitly. Do not convert this peak to RMS with sqrt(2).

The project stores six aggregate FM300 By samples linked to the CH1 model pair, not per-well measurements. Experimental provenance supplied by the user: pooled full measurements of CH1 and CH2 on three separate 4D boxes; the observed channel readings match very closely, and their average is applied to all channels. CH3 is not directly measurable and is inferred from identical coil pairs and spacing. Raw per-channel/per-box readings are not separately stored here. Saved factor 7.65628549294111 is shared to all channels. Refit of the same aggregate samples under Auto and fixed Exact reproduced it exactly. Only this derivative has refreshed fit provenance; fit residuals do not measure independent validation or between-box variability.

24 well-centre points at world Z=0, pitch 19.3 mm, plate centred and unrotated. They are points, not liquid-volume averages. 2D XY grid: 81x81 over 130mm; view cropped to plate envelope. 3D: full31x31x31 XYZ grid through a130mm cube; earlier slice views replaced. Fixed Exact spatial solver. All new maps use shared 0–60 µT display scale; >=60 saturates, raw numerical fields are retained. Spatial grid convergence has not been established.

Thomas temporal table: original 1800 s exposure, continuous waveform, 500ms states 1,2,3,1+2+3, native RL/routing resolver, unchanged 3.3ms terminal zero segment. +/-4.08 V across 2x255 ohm corresponds to +/-8mA DC-equivalent; each coil inductance is .155 H. Currents combine as vectors, not magnitudes. Full exposure sampled at 0.5ms and checked at 1ms: per-well peaks unchanged, RMS difference <=0.00215 µT (0.0255%). Sampled peaks are not mathematically certified continuous maxima. Peak-time ties/plateaus may yield different argmax times. Optocoupler dynamics are not explicitly modeled; channel/box variability and uncertainty cannot be quantified from the six saved aggregate points. No biological/dose inference is made.

Original exposure, waveform, measurement dataset and both pre-existing maps are retained. No HM analysis or sharing performed.

Source-document cross-check (inspection supplied by parent task):
12 axial radial profiles: three third-generation boxes x channels 1/2 x coil sides A/B. Nominal 5 V DAC DC, one channel at a time, no rotation, field-off relative zero, 5 s settling; distance from channel centre. Six saved absolute By values match the reported pooled means at r=0,10,20,30,40,50 mm within rounding (maximum 0.000033 uT). At 51.7 mm six readings are Over Range and six are numeric (101.019–103.569 uT): an incomplete/censored group. None are in the saved six-point fit; no limit substitution or complete 12-profile mean is used. Saved negative By is consistent with model pair normals toward -Y; positive source magnitudes do not establish directly measured signed components. The reported PDF arithmetic 49.13+17.27=64.4mm is inconsistent (sum66.4mm), with sensor offset .68in approximately17.27mm. The user recalls a report typo and confirms the sensor centre was aligned with the coil centres. Coil-centre alignment is the intended physical reference; neither 64.4mm nor66.4mm is selected as a verified absolute height. Geometry was not changed. Off-axis, CH3 and time-dependent behavior remain model-inferred.


FULL-VOLUME REVISION: The four new 3D slice views have been replaced by native Full Volume maps. Each contains one Plotly volume trace on a complete31x31x31 XYZ grid over a130mm cube, not a stack of slice surface traces. This native Plotly renderer displays semi-transparent isosurfaces through the full scalar grid. Colours use0–60uT with renderer values>=60 clipped; original full scalar data are preserved in customdata/hover. Opacity settings expose plate/coil context. 2D maps and exact per-well tables are unchanged. Existing slice-convergence findings apply to the earlier slice views, not proof of this volume grid convergence.


FULL-VOLUME QUALITY CHECK: All four current 3D maps contain a single native Plotly volume trace, each with29,791 XYZ samples (31 distinct coordinates per axis), no slice surface traces and no slice slider. Native hidden PlotView rendering and PNG export succeeded for all8 new maps without any network requests, from a relocated project copy. Native volume rendering uses semi-transparent isosurfaces through the complete scalar grid. Point hovers now show exact per-well Bx, By, Bz and |B| predictions at the stored coordinates.

SPATIAL LIMIT: This31^3 volume grid is for visualization. Probe-based trilinear refinement31->61, including all24 wells, reduced the worst well-centre absolute interpolation difference from0.6524 to0.2323uT; worst relative difference from14.16% to4.58% near cancellation. This is not a fully converged quantitative volume or exhaustive error bound. Use the direct exact point hovers/CSV for well numbers. 2D81->161 refinement at well centres reduced worst absolute difference0.1433->0.0406uT and worst relative difference1.517->0.629%.
